answer: Old fable: one farmer tends one orchard well. Make every identity custodian of a unique orchard whose blight, drought and pruning dates are split by a prism from a shared season — same weather, different pattern per plot. Rewards pay only at harvest for trees kept alive by plot-specific care recorded over weeks. A sybil fleet must actually tend N diverging orchards daily; uniform scripted care kills most trees, and hiring attention per clone erases the profit from faking numbers.
